Package paint.shared.objects

Class Square

java.lang.Object
paint.shared.objects.Square
public class Square extends Object
Represents a rectangular analysis region (“square”) in a PAINT recording.

Each square stores its geometric origin, statistics derived from associated tracks, and flags describing visibility and exclusion status.

  • Constructor Details

    • Square

      public Square()
      Creates an empty Square.

    • Square

      public Square(String uniqueKey, String experimentName, String recordingName, int squareNumber, int rowNumber, int colNumber, double x0, double y0, double x1, double y1)
      Creates a fully-specified Square with geometric coordinates.
      Parameters:
      uniqueKey - a unique identifier for this square (typically exp§rec§num)
      experimentName - name of the experiment containing this square
      recordingName - name of the recording containing this square
      squareNumber - index of this square in the recording (0..N-1)
      rowNumber - row index in the grid
      colNumber - column index in the grid
      x0 - top-left x coordinate in µm
      y0 - top-left y coordinate in µm
      x1 - bottom-right x coordinate in µm
      y1 - bottom-right y coordinate in µm
